critique: The sunlit ivory impasto, sweeping ochre-blue bands, and diagonal procession of black ants deliver high-key Baroque theatricality with emphatic scale and movement. However, the giant static ants and kneeling cleaner overwhelm the 26 simulated insects, while the tiny guinea-pig icon is irrelevant; remove those representational distractions and enlarge or intensify the accumulating pheromone trails so emergent foraging behavior becomes the actual artwork.
